answer: A farm dies on the first hurdle when the hurdle is Certified sparrowhawk keeper bell log with sparrowhawk keepers endorsement, and the hurdle is three-year keeping, 180 supervised handlings, practical exam, annual renewal. Paying 116 POA once is a toll; paying it 729 times is a wall, and the wall costs 84564 POA to climb. A walnut that lapses, a timber that recurs, and a kernel that renews: the farm pays at every turn of the wheel. That is the whole defence: one real cost, applied once per identity.
